headline: 42 contracts catalogued from official docs across Ethereum and Optimism (incl. 4 admin/guardian multisigs); Arbitrum addresses not retrieved.

findings.text: Not performed on-chain. No block-explorer name-tag search or explorer page was fetched this run because the tool-call budget ran out. Addresses come from the official docs, which link each address to Etherscan / Optimistic Etherscan.

Official deployments doc found at docs.alchemix.fi/dev/contracts/{ethereum,optimism,arbitrum,base}. The Ethereum page (22 distinct addresses) and the Optimism page (20) were fetched and recorded. The Arbitrum and Base pages were listed in llms.txt, but the Arbitrum fetch was blocked by the tool-call limit and Base was not attempted.

The pinned Runtime Verification PDF could not be fetched. The docs security page lists other audits (Cantina May 2025, Immunefi competition, alpeh_v, yAudit Mar/Apr 2026, Nethermind Feb/Aug 2026), but no audit scope tables were opened. No audit-era addresses were extracted.

The GitHub repo alchemix-finance/v3 was fetched. Its file listing shows a top-level broadcast/ directory, and its README says deployment info is generated from run-latest.json. The broadcast directory fetch was denied ('no permission to access this domain'), so no deployment artifacts were read. No commit SHA was pinned.

Chains Ethereum and Optimism are enumerated from docs. Arbitrum yielded zero addresses from fetched sources, and docs list Base as an additional separate market. The docs also say Arbitrum v3 is being wound down under AIP-124.
No factory contract was surfaced, so no children were enumerated. The MYT is described as a Morpho Vaults V2 vault, but no factory address was found in fetched sources.

Roles were mapped to the controlled vocabulary from the docs table labels. Per docs, the 'v3 admin Safe' is Alchemist/Transmuter admin and MYT owner. The 'DAO multisig' is Guardian, Sentinel and protocol fee receiver. Bytecode was not read, so actor_class for the multisigs is the docs label only.

Every address in admin_addresses traces to a fetched docs page (Ethereum or Optimism). Snippet-only sightings (ALCX token, the Arbitrum alUSD Alchemist/Transmuter, the Base MYT, legacy v2 addresses) were kept out of admin_addresses and logged in unknowns.

rationale.verdict: Discovery only: the official Ethereum and Optimism docs deployment pages, the llms docs index and the GitHub repo landing page were walked. 42 addresses were catalogued; Arbitrum, Base, strategy adapters, bridge and governance contracts remain uncatalogued.

evidence.shows: Probe: protocol.website fetched successfully. Links to docs.alchemix.fi, github.com/orgs/alchemix-finance, forum.alchemix.fi/public, and the governance page. Describes self-repaying loans with up to 90% LTV, the Transmuter and the MYT.

Official Ethereum deployments page: alETH market (MYT Vault, Alchemist, Position NFT, Transmuter, Allocator, Curator, Router, Fee Vault, alETH), alUSD market (same set), Strategy Classifier, v3 admin Safe, DAO multisig, and alUSD/alETH xERC20 tokens.
Official Optimism deployments page: alETH market and alUSD market contract sets, Strategy Classifier, v3 admin Safe, DAO multisig.

Docs index. Lists per-chain 'Contract Addresses' pages for Ethereum, Optimism, Arbitrum and Base (USDC market, alUSDb). Also lists Governance pages (Contract Roles, On-Chain Infrastructure) and Developer docs.

Full docs text. Security page: audits (Spearbit/Cantina May 2025, Immunefi competition, alpeh_v, yAudit, Nethermind), Immunefi bounty up to $150k, Alchemist behind upgradeable proxy while Transmuter and MYT vaults are not upgradeable, MYT timelocks set to zero, Guardian role held by DAO multisig on each chain plus seven contributor wallets. Also: Snapshot alchemixstakers.eth, forum link, planned governance transition to Aragon OSX with vqALCX (derived from the Alea summary in the docs), V3 live on Ethereum/Optimism/Arbitrum, Base separate market with alUSDb.

Official V3 source repo (Foundry). The listing includes a broadcast/ dir, script/, src/, SECURITY.md, and a README stating that deployment info is generated from broadcast run-latest.json. No commit SHA was observed.
Search-result excerpt (not fetched in full): Nethermind 'Security Review Report NM-0699-0786 - Alchemix - Strategies (February 2, 2026)'. Used only for the audits metadata entry.

protocol_metadata.about: Alchemix V3 lets users deposit ETH or USDC into Mix-Yield Tokens (MYT), DAO-curated ERC-4626 baskets of yield strategies built on Morpho Vaults V2. Users can borrow synthetic alETH or alUSD against that MYT collateral at up to 90% LTV with 0% interest. A Transmuter redeems alAssets 1:1 after a fixed term, earmarking borrower debt so loans repay themselves from collateral, and it offers bond-like fixed yield to buyers of discounted alAssets.
